propositions: Linux bwrap enforcement tests skip silently in CI because unprivileged CLONE_NEWUSER is denied by both AppArmor and seccomp, causing probe() to return None and all @live gated tests to skip without proving enforcement works
The functional probe must assert the child process ran and writes outside the allow-list were denied; probes without a liveness check incorrectly report success when bwrap fails to start

A privileged container lane with REBAR_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_ENFORCEMENT=1 flag is required to execute (not skip) bwrap enforcement tests, with precondition validation that fails loudly if the mechanism is unavailable
The CI lane must run with --privileged to clear both the AppArmor userns restriction and the runtime's default seccomp filter, allowing bwrap to enforce write-deny on Linux
The enforcement mechanism must be portable via OCI runtime capabilities and reproducible locally on a developer laptop, not dependent on CI-provider-specific constructs
